contract.intended_consumer: Brian and coding agents starting consequential Agentic Engineering work
contract.outcome: A selected repository rejects a structurally incomplete new plan before coordination mutation, carries exact plan-revision custody into successor work units, and exposes the accepted contract through accurate operator documentation.

canonical_journey.starting_state: PI-02C is accepted on main, its exact v5 maintenance allocation remains active on the closed runtime-binding claim, and PI-02E is ready only through a restricted transition-input bootstrap.
canonical_journey.input: The exact active v5 allocation, one revision-bound PI-02E claim and selection-pending tracker, the accepted Plan 125 graph, and a v6 contract limited to transition artifacts plus the two PI-02D documentation surfaces.
canonical_journey.action: Park v5, allocate and select v6 on the exact live successor claim through the merged runtime plan-binding control, then prove post-selection heartbeat and both-sign prewrite behavior.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Claim, tracker, worktree, plan graph, allocation, and selection agree on one revision-bound PI-02E lane; the documentation paths are admitted only after selection while source, tests, AES, and unrelated plan paths remain denied.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: The closed PI-02C claim supplies current authority; a pending claim writes documentation; v5 remains active while v6 allocates; allocation or selection binds another claim; baseline validation is bypassed; or any out-of-scope path is admitted.
